# Create a simple character-level embedding

chars = sorted(
    set("".join(str(x) for x in train_df["before"]) + str(x) for x in train_df["after"])
)
char_to_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(chars)}
vocab_size = len(chars) + 250  # Base vocab size

# Encode sequences
print("Encoding sequences...")
train_before_encodings = []
train_after_encodings = []
for idx, row in train_df.iterrows():
    before_seq = " ".join([char_to_idx.get(c, 250) for c in row["before"]])[
        :50
    ]  # Limit to 50 chars
    after_seq = " ".join([char_to_idx.get(c, 250) for c in row["after"]])[:50]

    before_enc = [ord(c) % 256 for c in before_seq]
    after_enc = [ord(c) % 256 for c in after_seq]

    train_before_encodings.append(before_enc)
    train_after_encodings.append(after_enc)


# Simple neural network for token-level prediction
class TokenNormalizer(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = torch.nn.Linear(10, 128)
        self.fc2 = torch.nn.Linear(128, vocab_size)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = torch.relu(self.fc1(x))
        out = torch.sigmoid(self.fc2(x))
        return out
